tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding comparison analysis

tickets.evidence: They agreed that the comparison is to be prepared by 2026-04-24.

tickets.title: Complete taxable lot review for in-kind giving

tickets.title: Gather business sale documents for gift timing

tickets.title: Clarify donor identity for pledge and receipt records
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy where the Paper Otter Literacy Fund draft pledge lists Jonas individually while the household plan describes joint giving by Jonas and Nadia and a possible donor-advised fund grant path.

tickets.title: Resolve Amber Teapot portal and account registration
tickets.text: Fix the Amber Teapot Charitable Trust portal login issue where the verification code was sent to an old phone number and update the account profile to remove the former mailing address.

tickets.title: Handle Paper Otter pledge package logistics

tickets.title: Update philanthropy plan for potential business sale
